policy: Accepted-source counts and per-record accepted status in the candidate manifest describe retained local artifacts only. For ordinary research, a human-reviewed official link is usable within the publisher, identity, language, date/cutoff, relevant content and limitations checked; no capture, hash, replay, conversion or copying permission is required for link use. The government-published consolidated text is preferred where available; check a specific later change only when it may materially affect the provision at issue. Local artifact acceptance does not establish topic coverage or country completion.

publisher_assessment.decision: Nine ELI legal-record pages are accepted for human link use within their individually stated scopes and limits. This is not acceptance of the downloaded or converted local files.
publisher_assessment.basis: ELI is the official Polish legal information portal, and the reviewed record pages expose official publication identifiers, text and legal-status/version metadata. The latest identified government-published consolidated text is preferred; where ELI shows later amendments, the reference is expressly dated and those changes are checked only when material to the question.
publisher_assessment.limitation: Polish-language legal references only. ELI statuses and amendment indicators are as displayed on 2026-10-21. A dated page with later amendments is not represented as a complete current consolidation. No topic or country-level completeness is asserted.
